name: Soju & Gamja
description: A user-friendly IRC bouncer with the modern Gamja web interface.

files.content:
db sqlite3 /db/main.db
message-store db
file-upload fs /uploads/
listen irc+insecure://0.0.0.0:6667
listen ws+insecure://0.0.0.0:80
listen unix+admin:///run/soju/admin

connection.title: Open Gamja Web IRC
connection.description: Your Soju IRC bouncer and Gamja web client are running.

firstLogin.note: To create your initial administrator account, run this inside the bouncer container terminal: sojudb -config /soju-config create-user <username> -admin

features.title: Persistent IRC Bouncer
features.description: Stay connected to your favourite IRC networks with full message history and scrollback.

features.title: Modern Web Client
features.description: Access your bouncer from any browser via the responsive Gamja interface.
